  official record and will be distributed to the Mayor and City Council members prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. All written correspondence MUST be received by no later
  than Tuesday, February 23, 2021 at 4:00pm. If submitting a comment pertaining to an agenda
  item, please reference the agenda item.
  VIA PHONE VOICE MESSAGE FOR CALL­BACK: A person may also leave a voice message and
  provide name and phone number to receive a call back during the public comment section. If the
  comment pertains to an agenda item, you must reference the agenda item in your voice message.
  Contact: 562.420­2641, Ext. 251. Each caller will be given 3 minutes to speak. All messages MUST

CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, February 23, 2021
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

 Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
 Jesse Alvarado, Council Member  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager
 Myra Maravilla, Council Member  Luis Roa, Mayor  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
 Maria Teresa Del Rio, Council Member  Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Chairmember Roa on Tuesday, February 23, 2021 at 5:30 PM in the City Council
Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, provided brief information relating to the conduct of the
virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the agenda.

INVOCATION

Mayor requested a moment of silence to pay a tribute to the 500,000 lives lost to Covid-19.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

Mayor Roa
Mayor Pro Tem Farfan
Councilmember Alvarado
Councilmember Maravilla
Councilmember Del Rio

Poonam Davis, Interim City Clerk, announced a quorum.

 PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

There were no Proclamations at this time.

 PRESENTATIONS

There were no Presentations at this time

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, stated 2 persons have requested a call back for
public comment. There were 3 public comments received via e-comments. Those
comments were distributed to all councilmembers prior to the meeting.

Ramie Torres, spoke.

Frances Rodriguez spoke.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION

City Attorney Megan Garibaldi announced 2 items from closed session, items 1 and 2
will be discussed before consent calendar. The remaining closed session items will be
discussed at the end.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt the Agenda organization with changes.

AYES:  ROA, FARFAN, ALVARADO, MARAVILLA, DEL RIO
NOES:  NONE
EXCUSED:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.
The City Council recessed to close session @ 6:11 pm.

The City Council reconvened @ 6:40 pm.

City Attorney, Megan Garibaldi, stated there was no reportable action taken for Agenda
Items 1 and 2 from closed session.

 E. NEW BUSINESS

 F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

  City Manager Hernandez shared information regarding ordinance to prohibit price

  Mayor Roa shared information regarding opening of schools.

  Council Member Del Rio thanked Public safety officers for keeping the city safe.

  City Manager Hernandez thanked AFSCME members on agreeing and meeting in
  the middle.

  Mayor Roa also thanked AFSCME Rank and File and Management members on
  agreeing on the contract.
